caption.text: Most teams reach for GraphQL subscriptions and inherit a broker, a reconnect state machine, and a cache reconciliation problem — to save 2.5 seconds nobody asked for. This handbook walks the whole stack: the two-phase execution model, graphql-transport-ws message by message, pub/sub backends from EventEmitter to Kafka, fan-out cost math, and the exact arithmetic that tells you to just poll instead. Ten pages, every gotcha we have paid for.
